title: The Magic of Boundaries
coreMove: Ordinary-life expansion begins when you protect one small limit at a time, so sleep, work, family, movement, friendship, and rest stop being crowded out.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A fun episode can quietly spend the next morning's workout.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show sleep protected over Top Chef and Restaurant Wars.

exampleSpecs.audience: a reader answering a request with warmth and limits
exampleSpecs.stakes: A rushed yes could crowd the week and sour the friendship.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Respond to a friend and colleague's email from capacity.

exampleSpecs.audience: a working parent trying to keep health in the week
exampleSpecs.stakes: The gym slot can vanish if every family and work need enters first.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Keep parenting, work, and exercise from consuming one another.

exampleSpecs.audience: a reader learning from a missed self-boundary
exampleSpecs.stakes: A late night can become useful data instead of shame.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the morning cost of Restaurant Wars to reset the bedtime boundary.

exampleSpecs.audience: a reader auditing where the week keeps shrinking
exampleSpecs.stakes: The calendar will keep treating protected time as spare time unless named.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Audit a Monday after school schedule with son, work calendar, and gym.

exampleSpecs.audience: a reader balancing friendship with honest response timing
exampleSpecs.stakes: A caring email can become either avoidance or overpromise.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show a friend and colleague email answered within real capacity.
